map.基于 SCORAD（Severity Scoring of Atopic Der: Based on the SCORAD (Severity Scoring of Atopic Dermatitis) standard, assess the severity of atopic dermatitis/eczema from three dimensions: lesion area (A), lesion intensity (B), and subjective symptoms (C).
map.A. 皮损面积（占体表百分比，0-100）: A. Lesion area (percentage of body surface, 0-100)
map.使用「九分法」估算：头颈9%、双上肢各9%、躯干前18%、躯干后18%、双下肢各: Estimate by the 'Rule of Nines': head-neck 9%, each upper limb 9%, anterior trunk 18%, posterior trunk 18%, each lower limb 18%, perineum 1%.
map.B. 皮损强度（6项，各0-3分，最高18分）: B. Lesion intensity (6 items, each 0-3, max 18)
map.C. 主观症状（各0-10分，最高20分；由患者近3天平均评分）: C. Subjective symptoms (each 0-10, max 20; patient's average score over the last 3 days)
map.需规范外用治疗，必要时系统干预: Standardized topical therapy is needed, with systemic intervention if necessary
map.建议系统治疗，考虑生物制剂: Systemic therapy is recommended; consider biologics
map.SCORAD = A/5 + 7×B/2 + C = A/5 + 3.5×B +: SCORAD = A/5 + 7×B/2 + C = A/5 + 3.5×B + C (A is area %, B is intensity score, C is subjective score). Children may use objective SCORAD (only A/5 + 7B/2).

map.示例：面积 30%、六项强度均 2、瘙痒 7/睡眠 5 → 工具按加权算出 SC: Example: area 30%, all six intensity items 2, itch 7/sleep 5 → the tool computes SCORAD about 40+ by weighting, moderate-to-severe, suggesting stronger emollient and anti-inflammatory care.
map.SCORAD 越高越重吗？: Does a higher SCORAD mean more severe?
map.是的，SCORAD 综合面积、体征与瘙痒睡眠，越高病情越重，常用于随访与疗效评估: Yes, SCORAD integrates area, signs, and itch/sleep; higher means more severe, commonly used for follow-up and efficacy assessment.
